description: The plot illustrates the performance of "Whisper fine-tunning, type = small" by comparing four different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "epoch" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at regular intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled "WER" and features a linear scale ranging from 25.0 to 42.5, with tick marks spaced at intervals of 2.5. All four lines in the plot are orange. The line representing "small AdaLoRA_int4" is a solid line with circular markers, showing a steady decline from approximately 35.6 at epoch 0 to 30.5 at epoch 6. The "small AdaLoRA_int8" line is a solid line with square markers, which also steadily decreases from roughly 30.1 at epoch 0 to 25.1 at epoch 6. The "small int4" line is a dashed line with circular markers; it begins at approximately 30.1 at epoch 0, rises sharply to a peak of 42.1 at epoch 2, and then declines steadily to end at 31.5 at epoch 6. Finally, the "small int8" line is a dashed line with square markers, starting at roughly 30.1 at epoch 0, increasing to 33.7 at epoch 2, declining to 25.4 at epoch 5, and slightly rising to end at 25.9 at epoch 6.
